question: A handbag, a shirt, and a jacket were bought at Rs. 2,300 each. They are sold at 12% profit, 15% loss and 6% gain, respectively. The total profit percentage or loss percentage is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**As CP is the same for all three products.

Let the CP be 100.

Total Cp = 3 × 100 = 300.

A handbag, a shirt, and a jacket are sold at 12% profit, 15% loss and 6% gain.

So total gain will be = 12(Profit) + 6(Profit) - 15(Loss) = 3(Profit)

Profit % = 3/300 × 100 = 1%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**
